# SD18 deterministic Human Barbarian level 11 Greater Rage fixture.
# Widens the accepted SD13-E5 deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human
# Barbarian level-1..level-10 martial chassis baseline
# (tests/sd13_barbarian_level10_progression.rs) to level 11 as chosen
# input only. It names selections; it does not contain derived, computed, or
# parity values. It preserves the accepted Human race-choice seam
# (ability-bonus and bonus-feat) and the deterministic
# ability/feat/skill/equipment posture from the level-1 through level-10
# fixtures, adding only the level bump this bounded tranche needs. No new
# rage-power choice-slot line is present: the next rage-power grant level
# is 12th (2/4/6/8/10 are already granted; 11th is not a rage-power level),
# so no new choice= line is required beyond the level-1..level-10 baseline.
#
# It deliberately avoids every later Barbarian burden surface: no rage
# execution (activation, round tracking, fatigue), no rage-power
# recognition or execution, no damage-reduction application engine, and no
# level-12+ progression. The PF1 Core Rulebook Barbarian class table's
# level-11 "Special" column reads "Greater rage" only (verified
# independently against d20pfsrd and legacy.aonprd.com): Greater Rage
# upgrades the flat while-raging Strength/Constitution morale bonuses from
# +4 to +6 and the Will-save morale bonus from +2 to +3 (the Armor Class
# penalty stays -2); it does not add a new rage-power grant, so no
# rage-power-selection-slot-count engine is invented here.
case_id=pf1-crb-human-barbarian-level11
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:human
class_level=class:barbarian:11
ability=strength:16
ability=dexterity:14
ability=constitution:16
ability=intelligence:8
ability=wisdom:10
ability=charisma:8
feat=feat:power_attack
skill=skill:survival:1
equipment=item:chain_shirt:equipped_worn_active
equipment=item:longsword:equipped_primary_active
equipment=item:shield:absent
choice=choice:level_1_character_feat:feat:power_attack
choice=choice:human_bonus_feat:feat:dodge
choice=choice:human_ability_bonus:ability:strength
provenance=programs/codex/requirements/SD-18-core-rules-breadth/artifacts/core-roster-and-support-state-matrix.md
